description: Combine a small‑population Differential Evolution search over object centre coordinates with an exact linear‑program computation of the maximal uniform size for each candidate, followed by a short local gradient‑based polish.

guidance.idea: Run DE on the continuous variables representing object positions. For every DE individual, solve an LP that maximises the common size subject to non‑overlap constraints (the LP is exact for a fixed set of centres). Take the best DE individuals and run a few iterations of the existing local optimiser (e.g., SLSQP) to fine‑tune the positions.
guidance.transfer_rule: Best suited for packing problems where the maximal uniform size can be expressed as a linear programme given fixed positions (e.g., circle/sphere packing, rectangle placement).
actions: Initialize a small DE population with diverse centre coordinates.
Iterate DE generations using a simple overlap‑penalty fitness.
For each individual, solve the LP that yields the optimal uniform size.
Select the top‑k individuals and run a short SLSQP refinement on their positions.
Return the best feasible solution found.
cautions: LP solves add overhead; keep the DE population small to respect runtime budgets.
DE is stochastic – use a fixed random seed if reproducibility is required.
Ensure the LP formulation correctly captures all non‑overlap constraints.
